subject: Ciências
description_pt: Propor ações coletivas para otimizar o uso de energia elétrica em sua escola e/ou comunidade, com base na seleção de equipamentos segundo critérios de sustentabilidade (consumo de energia e eficiência energética) e hábitos de consumo responsável.

components.description_pt: Comparar eletrodomésticos usando critérios de sustentabilidade como consumo energético e eficiência energética
components.description_en: Compare household appliances using sustainability criteria such as energy consumption and energy efficiency ratings
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the efficiency of an energy-conversion device by analyzing energy input and output

components.description_pt: Selecionar eletrodomésticos baseado em critérios de eficiência energética e consumo responsável
components.description_en: Select appliances based on energy efficiency and responsible consumption criteria
components.cc_component_description: Compare two or more design solutions based on how well each meets specified criteria

components.description_pt: Propor ações coletivas para otimizar o uso de eletricidade em escolas ou comunidades
components.description_en: Propose collective actions to optimize electricity use in school or community settings
components.cc_component_description: Apply scientific principles to propose strategies that minimize a specific human impact on the environment

cc_matches.description: Design, build, and refine a device that works within given constraints to convert one form of energy into another form of energy.
Because there is always more than one possible solution to a problem, it is useful to compare and test designs.
Apply scientific principles to design a method for monitoring and minimizing a human impact on the environment.
